# Rebecca 1.9.4

Rebecca 1.9.4 makes nodes connect through their configured proxy and fixes the MirzaBot and Faoxima installers for their current releases.

## Nodes

- The HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy set on a node is now used when the panel connects to it. Before, the setting was saved and shown but ignored, so a node behind a blocked IP stayed disconnected. The connection is rebuilt when the proxy settings change.

## External apps

- MirzaBot 0.9.3 stores its settings in a `config` table. The webhook secret is now written there, so the bot accepts Telegram updates (#191).
- MirzaBot cron now runs through `cronbot/run.php` and includes the `alert_balance` and `optimize_order` jobs.
- Faoxima now gets the webhook secret that its own code verifies and a cron driven by `cron/cron.php`, with a larger PHP pool so cron work cannot starve the webhook.
- Existing MirzaBot and Faoxima installs are repaired when the panel starts, so a reinstall is not needed.

## Upgrade notes

> No database changes in this release.
